brief.title: User and parent task brief
brief.summary: Demanding complete Fieldwork website and real React Native companion app; flex/Yoga portability; no component catalog/composer; original fictional sample publication.

rules.title: Set task and information priority before style
rules.condition: Every surface declares Read, Operate or Persuade from its immediate task, not its product category.
observable: Declare primary task, three ordered information priorities, supporting regions and necessary actions.
Reviewers identify dominant region and next step from full rendering before seeing priority labels.

currentToolMapping.coverage: descriptive rectangles only; semantic input required

limits: Priority metadata and rectangle size cannot establish perceived hierarchy or task success.
A publication cover may invite reading; a reader surface must not inherit conversion-page structure.

rules.title: Keep supporting evidence connected to the claim
rules.condition: A cover/issue preview makes a factual, editorial or product claim.
observable: Record claim-to-source/caption/detail relations.
Supporting detail remains available and unambiguously attached after reflow.

currentToolMapping.coverage: descriptive rectangles only; semantic input required
not a general editorial evidence graph

limits: Adjacency does not verify truth.
Do not add testimonials, usage statistics or guarantees merely to fill a template.

rules.title: Measure declared relationships rather than arbitrary card spacing
rules.condition: Comparable sibling regions have declared group/relationship IDs.
observable: Report per declared relation; inspect caption/image, label/value, issue/story and status/action bindings.
Unrelated neighbors should not appear more closely attached without a deliberate visible cue.

currentToolMapping.coverage: descriptive rectangles only; semantic input required

limits: No universal positive-margin threshold; overlapping, nested and bridging regions require interpretation.
Do not average every within-group pair when only a caption-to-image dependency matters.

rules.title: Switch composition when content stops fitting
rules.condition: A proposed row, rail, list/detail or ancillary column has measured minimum usable child widths.
rules.equation: rowFits = sum(minUsableWidth_i(textScale,locale)) + sum(gap_i) <= containerWidth - insetLeading - insetTrailing - paddingLeading - paddingTrailing
observable: Use explicit flex direction/wrap/grow/shrink/basis.
Choose split/stack/disclosure from task relations; remeasure actual text and preserve priority.

currentToolMapping.coverage: partial: current stack/split typography resolver; no general navigation/state model

limits: Fit is necessary, not sufficient for readability, hierarchy or a useful two-pane task.
No universal two-column iPad or always-visible desktop sidebar. Height/keyboard constraints also matter.

rules.title: Tune roles to face, language and task
rules.condition: A surface mixes headline, deck, prose, labels, metadata and numeric roles.
observable: Compare role contrast, phrase grouping, paragraph cadence, cap measures, caption rhythm and meaningful emphasis.
Record default-scale short tails/word fractures separately from enlarged-text failures.
Preserve actual copy/fonts; treat line-break intervention as a scoped variant.

currentToolMapping.coverage: line/box evidence
partial: current stack/split typography resolver; no general navigation/state model

limits: 45–75-character prose guidance is a starting hypothesis, not a universal limit for every script, table or display headline.
Browser balance/pretty wrapping is optional enhancement, not a native portability dependency.

rules.title: Reject global font and scale bans
rules.condition: Elaya B1 is proposed as a universal constraint.
observable: Do not ban italics, hyphens, 900 weight, system fonts or a justified second family.
Do not force Tailwind scale or downward snapping with inherited leading.
Retain a single-family preset only where appropriate; permit editorial emphasis and platform-native text roles.

currentToolMapping.coverage: supports authored fonts
partial: current stack/split typography resolver; no general navigation/state model

limits: A preset may restrict values intentionally, but must be named/editable and subordinate to the brief.

rules.title: Describe density by semantic region and task
rules.condition: A full composition contains multiple content groups.
observable: Compare distribution of reading load, action count and quiet intervals by region.
Operate surfaces retain useful scan density; stories retain reading cadence; cover emphasis should not make every story equally loud.

currentToolMapping.coverage: descriptive rectangles only; semantic input required

limits: Occupancy is not information density or a beauty score. Container backgrounds must not count as content occupancy.
No fixed desirable whitespace percentage; do not minimize information or maximize empty area.

rules.title: Allocate visual emphasis to semantic roles
rules.condition: The surface contains actions, current selection, statuses, imagery and editorial emphasis.
rules.equation: roleCoverage = unionArea(visibleRegionsWithRole)/visibleSurfaceArea; only when role ownership and occlusion are known
observable: Inspect where strongest color/contrast appears, competing focal regions and consistency across states.
Check actual role-pair contrast independently; image/gradient text needs resolved background evidence.

currentToolMapping.coverage: opaque sRGB declared-role contrast and perceptual descriptors
descriptive rectangles only; semantic input required

limits: Current color analyzer does not infer role areas, salience, occlusion or image contrast.
No 60/30/10 law; high chroma and neutral palettes are both legitimate conditional choices.

rules.title: Use concentric-radius geometry only when it applies
rules.condition: A rounded rectangle has a uniformly inset rounded child and the intended curves are concentric.
rules.equation: rInner = max(0, rOuterEffective - inset); inset and rOuterEffective refer to the same contour, with border offsets included
observable: Inspect equal corner spacing using actual rendered effective radii.
Declare square or intentionally nonconcentric exceptions.

currentToolMapping.coverage: missing: radius/contour metadata; rectangles alone are insufficient

limits: No universal gap<32 or result>2 cutoff.
CSS/renderer radius clamping, unequal inset, elliptical corners and borders need explicit geometry; constant-radius subtraction is not a general optical law.

rules.title: Reject mandatory decorative recipes
rules.condition: Fixed gradient, dark palette, icon library, border or island-navigation rules are proposed for all surfaces.
observable: Evaluate a selected visual direction and platform conventions instead.
Use separators where they clarify related rows; gradients only when authored and contrast-verified; no mandatory gradient heading.

currentToolMapping.coverage: opaque sRGB declared-role contrast and perceptual descriptors
descriptive rectangles only; semantic input required

limits: A named preset can encode these choices, but they cannot define design quality or accessibility.

rules.title: Make motion optional and task-related
rules.condition: Navigation, saving, downloads or reading transitions change state.
observable: Content is readable at initial/static/reduced-motion state.
Use motion to explain continuity or feedback; verify interruption and reduced-motion behavior.
Reject mandatory word reveals and >=800ms entrance delays.

currentToolMapping.coverage: missing: temporal/interaction evidence

limits: A cubic Bezier is an easing curve, not proof of a mass-spring model.
IntersectionObserver and requestAnimationFrame are implementation choices, not evidence that motion is performant or necessary.

rules.title: Prove necessary states and recovery
rules.condition: A real Fieldwork control performs navigation/search/save/download/reading.
observable: Exercise default/focus/active/selected/disabled/loading/empty/error states when applicable.
Use a proportionate progress indicator or skeleton according to operation; preserve entered query and recovery path.
No dead controls or misleading offline success.

currentToolMapping.coverage: partial: measurement receipts, not a complete interaction harness

limits: Not every element needs every state; hover is not a required touch affordance.
Screenshot presence does not demonstrate an action works.

rules.title: Use original truthful sample content
rules.condition: Proof artifacts contain editorial copy, names, metrics, imagery or claims.
observable: Label Fieldwork as an original fictional/sample publication.
Mark generated visual provenance and avoid unverified real-location captions.
Use authored sample datasets with units/source notes; never invent organic-looking conversion figures, readers, awards or testimonials as proof.

currentToolMapping.coverage: preserves declared rights/provenance, does not establish factual truth

limits: Specificity is useful only when the claim is supported.
Reject Elaya organic fake-number examples as a rule for credibility.

rules.title: Separate scoped accessibility checks from taste
rules.condition: Web content or native controls are claimed to meet a specific accessibility/platform requirement.
observable: For applicable web content, test reflow at320CSSpx and resize to200% without loss, respecting criterion exceptions.
Evaluate WCAG2.2 AA pointer-target24x24CSSpx or applicable exceptions; do not call44px the universal AA minimum.
Native target sizes, safe areas, Dynamic Type and platform units require separate platform evidence.

currentToolMapping.coverage: partial geometry/spacing evidence
opaque sRGB declared-role contrast and perceptual descriptors
target-renderer receipts; no complete conformance claim

limits: These checks are not a complete accessibility audit.
Browser viewport resizing alone does not prove zoom, screen-reader order, native text scaling or touch gestures.

rules.title: Require actual native runtime evidence
rules.condition: A proof is called an app design.
observable: Capture running React Native controls/layout on actual iOS/Android runtime, with engine/version/state hashes.
Exercise native navigation, search, save/offline and reading resume.
Phone tabs/tablet sidebar are candidate idioms; retain them only when task/window fit supports them.

currentToolMapping.coverage: available renderer receipts; app flow coverage must be added
partial: current stack/split typography resolver; no general navigation/state model

limits: A browser screenshot inside a phone frame is not native evidence.
Simulator evidence is valid as simulator evidence; hardware, gesture, performance and device-behavior gaps remain explicit.

rules.title: Preserve semantic order and task state during adaptation
rules.condition: Composition changes topology or navigation as window size/input/context changes.
observable: Selected issue/story, search query, scroll/reading position and saved state survive appropriate transitions.
Visual order, traversal order and spoken order remain coherent.
No required feature disappears at narrow width; disclosure provides an accessible path.

currentToolMapping.coverage: descriptive rectangles only; semantic input required
partial: current stack/split typography resolver; no general navigation/state model

limits: Current geometric reversals do not verify DOM/focus/accessibility order.
Scrolling/selection continuity needs executable actions and state receipts, not screenshots alone.

rules.title: Judge complete connected compositions
rules.condition: Toolkit changes claim improved design quality.
observable: Use the six connected Fieldwork surfaces and transitions defined in proofSuite.
Inspect full-page and viewport crops, including lower sections, not only title/prose.
Reviewers may reject all candidates or abstain; geometric feasibility is only entry to visual critique.

currentToolMapping.coverage: viable-option selector; no visual quality certification
synthetic labels/provenance and project split

limits: A larger screenshot count is not a100x quality measurement.
Same-model Astra labels remain synthetic and correlated, not human empirical validation.

rules.title: Keep evidence and evaluation boundaries intact
rules.condition: Rules or selection policies are proposed from rendered alternatives.
observable: Freeze project/surface/state hashes, source assets and train/heldout allocation before labels.
Keep all widths and states of one connected issue/story family together in a split.
Separate equation correctness probes, synthetic visual judgments and human outcomes.

currentToolMapping.coverage: project split and evidence binding
human-vs-synthetic evaluation boundary

limits: The existing six-pair title/prose dataset cannot validate the new full compositions.
Reference awards and model agreement do not demonstrate conversion, comprehension or task success.

proofSuite.truth: Original fictional/sample publication about architecture, place and fieldnotes. Generated imagery retains provenance.

surfaces.task: Understand the publication and open the current issue or lead story.
requiredRegions: dominant lead story and original observatory/cliff visual
acceptance: Lead story is unmistakable without making secondary stories look disabled.
Image crop preserves its editorial subject across widths; caption remains attached.
Next reading action is clear; no fabricated proof or decorative generic-card repetition.

surfaces.task: Scan a complete issue, understand its structure, choose a story and return.
acceptance: Story rank and section membership remain legible at every width.
Repeated metadata aligns while unequal story importance remains unequal.
Filters/contents links, if shown, work and preserve context.

surfaces.task: Read an extended feature, inspect a figure/note, navigate sections and continue reading.
requiredRegions: inline figure or map with meaningful original data/labels
acceptance: Sustained prose rhythm survives full article length; no repeated disconnected text cards.
Caption/quote/notes remain visually distinct from narrative.
Ancillary desktop column collapses without interrupting the article or losing reference relationships.

surfaces.task: Browse issues, search for a story, open it, return with query and position intact.
acceptance: A running native app demonstrates the flow; keyboard does not conceal query/results or trap navigation.
Phone and tablet composition supports its task; library/reader relationships survive resizing.
Search results retain query context and meaningful differentiation.

surfaces.task: Save a story, download it, inspect status, handle failure and reopen available content offline.
acceptance: Saved is not confused with downloaded.
Offline availability is backed by actual local content behavior; unsupported states are disclosed, not painted as success.
State changes remain clear through labels/shape as well as color, without shifting the entire list unexpectedly.

surfaces.task: Read, change supported text settings, save and resume the same story.
acceptance: Content leads; controls recede while remaining discoverable.
Text enlargement, safe areas and tablet measure support sustained reading.
Reading position and appropriate state survive return, rotation/window change and offline reopen.

proofSuite.variants: Two credible coherent art directions for the connected publication, plus a deliberately plausible feasible failure variant for diagnosis. Freeze each complete composition before labeling.
proofSuite.nativeCoverage: Genuine React Native phone runtime on iOS and Android; iPad portrait/landscape and supported narrow window where available. Native desktop is not claimed.
stateStress: 200% applicable web text enlargement and native supported accessibility text settings
RTL fixture with declared translation/fallback provenance
resize/rotation with selected story/query/reading position retained
proofSuite.acceptanceProtocol: All scoped hard checks must pass or have justified explicit exceptions; whole-composition critique independently assesses purpose, hierarchy, grouping, rhythm, imagery, density, responsive structure and native affordances. No average score can hide an unresolved severe issue.
proofSuite.evidence: Full-page/screen captures plus targeted crops, serialized semantic regions/relations, runtime receipts, actual interaction traces and source/state/asset hashes. Identify unavailable hardware and untested claims.

globalLimits: No universal beauty score, optimal color ratio, conversion guarantee or claim of100x measured improvement.
Adopt/adapt/reject records extraction decisions, not empirical validation.
Only flex/flex-wrap and explicit grow/shrink/basis layouts; no CSS Grid dependency.
General relations/constraints and proof fixtures are in scope; component catalog or UI composer is not.
